book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: SAN MARCOS Jesucristo yee Añurije Quetire Marcos cʉ̃ ca Owarique

content: Ca amo bʉʉricʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique
Jiro, nea poo juu buerica wiipʉre jãa waaupi ñucã Jesús. Tii wiipʉre niiupi jĩcʉ̃, cʉ̃ amo ca bʉʉricʉ.
Jĩcãrã Jesús're ca wedejãarʉgarã, jĩcã wãme cʉ̃ ca tii bui cʉtirijere ca ama niirã, “¿Yerijãarica rʉmʉrena cʉ̃ catiocãgʉti?” ĩirã, cʉ̃re ĩa doe niiupa.
To cõrora Jesús pea o biro ĩiupi, ca amo bʉʉricʉre: —Wãmʉ nʉcã doori, decomacã pee ea nʉcãña —ĩiupi.
Aperã peera o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi jãiñaupi: —¿Yerijãarica rʉmʉre ñeere to tii dotiti, añurijere, ñañarije peere, bojocare catioriquere, jĩa cõarique peere? —ĩiupi. Cʉ̃ja pea wedetiupa.

Jesús pea, ajiarique mena cʉ̃ weja ca niirãre ĩa, cʉ̃ja ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerʉgatirijere bʉaro tʉgoeñarique pairi, o biro ĩiupi ca amo bʉʉricʉre: —Mʉ amore juu pooya —ĩiupi. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, cʉ̃ amo cʉ̃ ca juu poorora añuri amo biicoaupa.
Fariseos pea witicoarãpʉa, Herodes cʉ̃ ca ĩirijere ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã mena nea poori, Jesús're cʉ̃ja ca jĩapere ameri wede peni jʉo waaupa.
Ʉtabʉcʉra tʉjarore paʉ bojoca cʉ̃ja ca nea poorique
Jesús, cʉ̃ buerã mena ʉtabʉcʉra tʉjaro cʉ̃ ca waaro, paʉ bojoca Galilea yepa macãrã cʉ̃jare nʉnʉ waaupa.
Niipetirije Jesús cʉ̃ ca tiirijere queti tʉori, paʉ bojoca, Judea macãrã, Jerusalén macãrã, Idumea macãrã, dia Jordán ape nʉña macãrã, Tiro, Sidón yepari macãrã Jesús're ĩarã dooupa.
To biirije cʉ̃ja ca biiro macã, Jesús pea, bojoca yʉre waa tuumicõabocuma ĩigʉ, cʉ̃ buerãre: “Petigaacã cũmua mʉja poo yuewa,” cʉ̃jare ĩiupi.
Paʉre cʉ̃ ca catioro macã, niipetirã ca diarique cʉtirã cʉ̃re padeñarʉgarã, tuu jua nʉnʉa dooupa.
Ñucã wãtĩa bojocapʉre ca niirã cãa, Jesús're ĩarãra, cʉ̃ jʉguero cʉ̃ja ãjʉro jupeari mena ea nuuri: —¡Mʉa, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ Macʉ̃ mʉ nii! —cʉ̃re ĩi acaro buirucuupa.
Jesús pea cʉ̃jare wede dotitiupi, cʉ̃ra cʉ̃ ca niirijere wede majiorema ĩigʉ.
Cʉ̃ buerã ca niiparãre Jesús cʉ̃ ca beje jeerique
Jiro Jesús ʉ̃tãgʉpʉ mʉa waa, cʉ̃ ca boorãre jʉoupi.
Cʉ̃ja pea cʉ̃ pʉto pee nea waaupa. Pʉa amo peti, dʉpore pʉaga penituaro ca niirã cʉ̃re bapa cʉti, añurije quetire wede doti cojo,
wãtĩare cõa wiene doti majirique cʉ̃jare ʉpo, cʉ̃ ca tiiparãre beje jeeupi.
Anija niiupa pʉa amo peti, dʉpore pʉaga penituaro niirã cʉ̃ ca beje jeericarã: Simón, ñucã cʉ̃rena Pedro cʉ̃ ca ĩiricʉ,
Zebedeo puna “Boanerges” cʉ̃ ca ĩiricarã, Santiago, cʉ̃ bai Juan, “Bʉpo Puna” ĩirʉgaro ĩi,
Andrés, Felipe, Bartolomé, Mateo, Tomás, Alfeo macʉ̃ Santiago, Tadeo, ñucã apĩ Simón celote bojocʉ,
apĩ Judas Iscariote jiro Jesús're ca wedejãa buiyee cõaricʉ, niiupa.
Jesús to biri Beelzebú
Jiro Jesús wiipʉ cʉ̃ ca jãa waaro, paʉ bojoca neaupa ñucã, Jesús, cʉ̃ buerã, do biro tii cʉ̃ja ca baa majitiropʉ.
“Mecʉ̃cã yai waami Jesús,” cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere tʉori, cʉ̃ yaarã pea cʉ̃re jʉorã waaupa.
Ñucã doti cũuriquere ca jʉo buerã Jerusalén'pʉ ca dooricarã cãa, o biro ĩiupa: “Beelzebú,
wãtĩa wiogʉ majuropeera cʉ̃ ca yeri tutuarijere cʉ̃ ca tiicojoricʉ niiri, wãtĩare cõa wiene majimi,” ĩiupa Jesús're.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩiro, Jesús pea cʉ̃jare jʉo cojo, ĩi cõoñarique mena cʉ̃jare wedeupi: “¿Do biro tiigʉ Satanás cʉ̃ majuropeera cʉ̃ cõa wienebogajati?
Jĩcã yepa macãrãra cʉ̃ja majuropeera ameri camotati, cʉ̃ja ca ameri ĩa juna niijata, añuro nii yapano nʉcãticuma.
Jĩcã wii macãrãra ameri camotati, cʉ̃ja ca ameri ĩa juna niijata, añuro nii yapano nʉcãticuma.
Tii wãmere birora Satanás cãa cʉ̃ yaarãrena cʉ̃ ca ĩa junajata, añuro jʉo nii majiticumi. To cõrora yapano nʉcãgʉ biicumi.
Jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera bojocʉ ca tutuagʉ yaa wiire jãa waari, cʉ̃re jia cũu jʉotigʉra cʉ̃ yee apeyere jee duti majiticumi. Cʉ̃re jia cũucã jʉoripʉ docare, cʉ̃ yee apeyere jee duti majibocumi.
Díámacʉ̃ mʉjare yʉ ĩi: Niipetirije ñañarije cʉ̃ja ca tiiriquere, ñañarije cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere, acoborucumi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.

To ca bii pacaro, Añuri Yerire ñañarije ca ĩi tutigʉ doca, ñañarije cʉ̃ ca ĩi bui cʉtiriquere, jĩcãti ʉno peera coe ecotirucumi. To birora ñañaro cʉ̃ ca ĩi bui cʉtirique menara bii yai nʉcãcãrucumi,” ĩiupi.
“Ca wãtĩ jãa ecoricʉ niimi” cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca ĩirije jʉori, atere to biro cʉ̃jare ĩiupi Jesús.
Cʉ̃ paco, cʉ̃ yaarã
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩi niiri tabera, Jesús paco, cʉ̃ bairã, eaupa. Macãpʉra tua nʉcãri, jĩcʉ̃re cʉ̃re jʉo dotirã tiicojo cojoupa.
Paʉ bojoca cʉ̃ weja ca duwirã pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupa: —Mʉ paco, mʉ bairã mʉre amama. Macãpʉ niima —ĩiupa.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩiro, o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi yʉʉupi: —¿Noa cʉ̃ja niiti, yʉ paco, yʉ bairã? —ĩiupi.
To biro ĩi, cʉ̃ weja ca duwi amojoderãre ĩa, o biro ĩiupi: —Anija niima yʉ paco, yʉ bairã, ca niirã.
No ca boorã Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca boorijere ca tiirã niima, yʉ bai, yʉ baio, yʉ paco, ca niirã —cʉ̃jare ĩiupi Jesús.
